import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3d7b5c54.py'

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bars=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v==row[0] and v!=0 for v in row)]
    for b in bars:
        up=b-1
        while up>=0 and not all(v==grid[up][0] and v!=0 for v in grid[up]):
            down=2*b-up
            if down<len(grid):
                for c,v in enumerate(grid[up]):
                    if v not in (0, grid[b][0]) and grid[down][c]==0: out[down][c]=v
                    if v not in (0, grid[b][0]) and out[down][c]==0: out[down][c]=v
            up-=1
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)

        color=grid[b][0]

                a=grid[b-d][c]; z=grid[b+d][c]
                if a not in (0,color) and z==0: out[b+d][c]=a
                if z not in (0,color) and a==0: out[b-d][c]=z
            d+=1
    return out
'''
